name_cn: 石家庄维宝莱纺织有限公司
main_products: Grey and finished woven fabrics (TC, polyester-cotton plain weave, high-density garment fabric, classic dacron 的确良), cotton and TC yarn
woven_evidence: It reports 700-1,000 shuttle and air-jet looms, and a stock listing shows a T65/C35 1/1 plain-weave grey fabric.

canton_fair.evidence_note: A China Textile News report on the 139th Canton Fair says the company showed 5 product categories and 300+ fabric varieties. It is also named in the Shijiazhuang government report on the 139th fair and in the 137th exhibitor report.

notes: An integrated spinning and weaving mill founded in 2004. Much of its output may be grey fabric and home-textile fabric, so Layer 2 should check how much it sells as finished apparel fabric.
